items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Philip Nixon. He was a fine guitar player. Couldn't read though, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, a few of them, like solos.

Now, another fine guitar player was playing with the Silver Leaf band. What was his name? What was his name? No, no. Philip Nixon? Philip Nixon. He was a fine guitar player. Couldn't read though, you know. But, yeah. Yeah, probably a nice guitar player. Yeah, probably a nice guitar player. Did they use an ordinary flat pick or would they ever pick with their fingers or whatever? Well, I never did look at them that close. You never did notice, huh? I didn't notice that close. They said they used to play with their…
I think the sales father could, you know.
